product.title: Columbia River Gorge Tour from Portland

description.text: Explore the Columbia River Gorge on a half-day small-group tour from Portland with stops at Multnomah Falls, Latourell Falls, and Vista House. A local guide handles transportation from downtown hotels so you can focus on gorge scenery and waterfall viewpoints.

highlights: Half-day Columbia River Gorge tour from Portland
Visit Multnomah Falls and Latourell Falls
Stop at Vista House for gorge panoramas
Small family-run operator with local guides
Hotel pickup and drop-off in downtown Portland

start.description: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point confirmed after booking.

end.description: Returns to the original Portland pickup location.

product.itinerarySummary: Explore the Columbia River Gorge on a half-day small-group tour from Portland with stops at Multnomah Falls, Latourell Falls, and Vista House.

itineraryItems.title: Downtown Portland pickup
itineraryItems.description: Meet at a downtown hotel or Pioneer Courthouse Square before departing east.

itineraryItems.title: Latourell Falls
itineraryItems.description: Stop at one of the gorge's most photographed plunge waterfalls.

itineraryItems.title: Vista House
itineraryItems.description: Take in wide Columbia River views from Crown Point.

itineraryItems.title: Multnomah Falls
itineraryItems.description: Visit the iconic two-tier waterfall and lodge area.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
